system.description:
Prosthetic Tools Table

Tool

Effect

Grappling Hook

As a Bonus action, you fire a chakra threaded cable at a surface or creature you can see within 30 feet, pulling yourself to the location without provoking opportunity attacks. If the target is a creature, make a ranged attack. On a hit, you pull yourself to the target ending your movement in the space or as close to the space as possible.

Elemental Vent

As an action you release a blast of elemental energy forcing all creatures in a 20-foot cone to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failed save and half as much on a success. If you have access to another nature release, you can use that element corresponding damage type. This damage increase by +1d6 at 7th, 10th and 14th levels.

Loaded Shuriken

As a bonus action you may make a ranged attack with a 30-foot range. On a hit, you deal 2d8 slashing damage and if they are concentrating on a jutsu they make their check to maintain concentration at disadvantage. This damage increases by +1d8 at 7th, 10th and 14th level.

Loaded Umbrella

As a Reaction to taking damage from an attack or failing a strength or Dexterity saving throw, you release a folding metallic shield in the shape of an umbrella to protect you. You gain a +2 bonus to your AC, and Strength and Dexterity saving throw possibly turning a hit to a miss or a failed save into a successful one. This bonus increase by +1 at 10th and 17th level.

Bladed Chain

As an Action, you release a serrated chain attempting to ensnare a creature. One creature you can see within 30 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are Grappled and takes your Lethal Attack as slashing or piercing damage (your choice). A Grappled creature can remake their saving throw at the end of each of their turns to escape.

Mist Censer

As a bonus action you release a chakra laced cloud of black mist centered on a point of the space you are in. This cloud fills a 10-foot cube and counts as heavy obscurement to all creatures excluding you. This cloud lasts until the beginning of your next turn. The size of the affected area increases to a 20-foot cube at 10th level.

Shinobi Firecracker

As a bonus action, you release a bushel of small explosives that explode with a flash of disorienting light. All creatures within 5 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw, being Dazed on a failed save.

Some Hunters are forged not by their past, but by surviving it. Scarred and reconstructed, these operatives carry with them a brutal efficiency born of hardship and a prosthetic gauntlet housing a variety of deadly ninja tools. Known as inheritors of the Wolf’s Legacy, they use perfect timing, cutting insight, and ruthless adaptation to exploit any opening.
